propositions: Plan review must migrate from Pass 1 discovery to S2 shared typed kernel while preserving chunk sizing, model ladders, cache warming, bounded concurrency, container/prerequisite stages, cancellation, and resumable checkpoint semantics.
Failed criteria and incomplete work must not serialize as clean checkpoints; earlier successes must survive, independent work must continue, and dependents must skip per approved failure policy.

Checkpoint identity must include all material inputs (plan, code/ref, criteria snapshot, prompt, contract, model/mode, topology, context, dependencies, namespace) such that any change invalidates cached envelopes and forces re-execution.
Only content-identical success/resume envelopes may seed reuse; failed, cancelled, skipped, and budget-shed units must remain missing and callable on rerun.
Review journal must store the safe versioned trace and digest-complete success-only envelopes while review-plan output contracts remain narrow end-result fields without per-unit detail.

Shadow comparison during migration must detect zero unapproved differences in call selection, order, context, model, budget, usage, cache, checkpoint, or final verdict between legacy and new implementations.
